Eval 14's scenario is already covered properly by evals/sim/scenarios.mjs (auto-shared-list, with fixture.mjs). Either give each eval a small fixture under evals/files/ and name it in the prompt the way evals 3, 4, 10 and 12 do, or cut the expectations to what a bare repo can show: eval 6 keeps only its anti-expectations; eval 14 asks for the rework to be attempted (or its absence stated) before any learning question.

findings.evidence: If a snippet still isn't found after two tries, log without `evidence_from`/`evidence_to`. / Passes evidence_from and evidence_to to log-event.mjs, and the logged event has a non-empty evidence_to_message
findings.fix: "without evidence_from/evidence_to" reads as both "drop both" and "drop whichever one the error named". The script's error names exactly one ("evidence_from was not found before evidence_to"), and in every single-prompt eval the mistake is narrated inside the user's prompt, so evidence_from can never match an agent message while evidence_to can. Whether evals 1, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9 and 10 meet their non-empty evidence_to_message expectation then depends on which reading the agent picks. Say it once: "drop only the snippet the error names and keep the other".

findings.evidence: A learning written some other way, say the user asked you to edit `docs/learnings/` directly, still needs its event: log it now as `new` with status `accepted` (and `replaces` if it superseded an old one), without asking again.
findings.fix: Minor rather than blocker because it is a positive branch, not a refusal, and the validator accepts the event either way. Two gaps: no eval exercises it (prompt: "I edited docs/learnings/x.md myself earlier, /learn"; expect one event, outcome new, status accepted, no AskUserQuestion), and the step-7 table has no row saying what options_shown and option_user_picked hold when nothing was shown. Add the row (`[]` and `""`, by analogy with occurrence) so two runs log it the same way.

findings.evidence: const plugin = { dir: PLUGIN_ROOT, events: join(`.${pluginName}`, "learning-events") }; … [`${pluginName.toUpperCase()}_LEARN_CHECK`]: "1" / return join(root || cwd, ".harness", "learning-events"); / const INSIDE_CHECK = "HARNESS_LEARN_CHECK";
findings.fix: Pattern: one name derived, the same name hardcoded elsewhere. run.mjs reads the plugin name from plugin.json to find the events folder and to set the hook's guard variable, while log-event.mjs and learn-hooks.mjs hardcode `.harness` and `HARNESS_LEARN_CHECK`. They agree today; a renamed plugin (the pre-release manifest already uses another name) makes the noNudge scenarios get nudged and every event check fail with no error naming the cause. Pick one side: hardcode both in run.mjs, or derive both in the scripts (log-event.mjs already reads plugin.json for the version).
